3239.note: Benedict's Chest (Tiragarde Keep, Durotar) opens only with Benedict's Key 4882, which Lieutenant Benedict 3192 drops (items.json: 4882 drops 100% from 3192); the chest holds the Aged Envelope 4881 that starts The Admiral's Orders 830, so 830 can be taken only after Benedict is killed (PR #467, #357; the knowledge base's 830 step: "Kill Lieutenant Benedict in Tiragarde Keep for his key, then open the chest"). No merged source records the lock.

source.ref: players' in-game recordings since launch: 7 people took Silver of the Waves (86614) from the toolbox, 4 at 47.9-48.2,39.7-39.9 (20261105T164040Z, 20261106T131246Z, 20261107T011351Z, 20261107T154948Z), and one each at 45.69,43.36 (20261107T132422Z), 50.63,53.29 (20261108T144805Z) and 48.74,54.42 (20261108T153303Z), the last three in the toolbox's own quest window

665289.note: The Discarded Fishing Toolbox, which offers Silver of the Waves (86614), lies on the bed of Loch Modan's loch at one of several places, not only the one the data had (48.06,39.70, east of Thelsamar): players took the quest from it at three more, 45.69,43.36 south-west of there and 48.74,54.42 and 50.63,53.29 at the loch's south end (their positions in the toolbox's window, within reach of it). A player who stood on the one known point found nothing to click (#1339). Replaces the map's single point with the four.
